info.name: Hospigo 8c settings and gaps
info.description: Step 8c (API): payment modes, vitals fields, bill number series, patient reference fields, doctor leave requests, per-branch print templates and extra print values. BEFORE RUNNING: (1) npm run prisma:migrate -w @hospigo/api (8c adds three migrations: number series protection, doctor leave requests, print values), (2) npm run prisma:seed -w @hospigo/api, (3) restart the API, (4) environment Hospigo Local with staffPassword, superadminPassword and branchAdminPassword. It adds test rows with the fixed codes POSTMAN8C / postman8c (running it again is fine: the second run sees 409 for the add steps) and one far-future leave that it removes again. It never lowers a counter and never deletes anything.

item.name: 5 Login SuperAdmin of the other hospital (south main)
9 Add a mode that needs a reference (201, or 409 on a second run)

exec: const m = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.code === 'POSTMAN8C'); pm.test('the test mode exists', () => pm.expect(m).to.be.an('object')); pm.collectionVariables.set('modeId', m.id);

item.name: 11 The same code twice is a conflict (409)

exec: pm.sendRequest({url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/settings/payment-modes', method: 'GET', header: {Authorization: 'Bearer ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('tSA')}}, (err, res) => { const c = res.json().items.find(x => x.code === 'CASH'); pm.collectionVariables.set('cashId', c.id); });

item.name: 17 The other hospital cannot change this mode (404)
20 Add a number field with a usual range (201, or 409 on a second run)

exec: const f = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.code === 'postman8c'); pm.test('exists', () => pm.expect(f).to.be.an('object')); pm.collectionVariables.set('fieldId', f.id);

item.name: 22 A lowest value above the highest is refused (400)
23 A text field cannot have a range (400)
29 Branch Admin is refused: money numbering is hospital-wide (403)
31 A start number of 0 is refused (400)
32 A start number needs a reason (400)
34 A prefix with a space is refused (400)
35 An unknown field in the format is refused (400)
36 Receptionist cannot add the ready-made fields (403)

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('created plus kept is four', () => pm.expect((b.created||[]).length + (b.kept||[]).length + (b.skipped||[]).length).to.eql(4));

item.name: 38 Pressing it again adds nothing new (200)
40 A made-up doctor id gives an empty queue, not an error

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('waiting', () => pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('PENDING')); pm.collectionVariables.set('reqId', b.id);

item.name: 44 An end before the start is refused (400)
45 A free-text reason is not accepted (400)
47 Doctor sees the request in the own list (200)
48 Receptionist cannot see the Admin list (403)
49 Doctor cannot use the Admin list (403)

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('listed', () => pm.expect(b.items.some(r => r.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('reqId'))).to.eql(true)); pm.test('count', () => pm.expect(b.pendingCount).to.be.at.least(1));

item.name: 51 The other hospital cannot approve it (404)
53 SuperAdmin approves (200): the leave is created

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('approved', () => pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('APPROVED')); pm.collectionVariables.set('docProfileId', b.doctor.id);

item.name: 55 The doctor cannot cancel an approved leave (409)
56 Admin removes the leave again through Availability (200)

exec: const l = pm.response.json().leaves.find(x => x.fromDate === pm.collectionVariables.get('leaveFrom')); pm.test('the approved leave exists', () => pm.expect(l).to.be.an('object')); pm.collectionVariables.set('leaveId', l.id);

item.name: 58 A new request can be cancelled by the doctor (200)
61 Reading needs only a login: the receptionist sees what applies (200)

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); pm.test('three documents', () => pm.expect(b.items.length).to.eql(3)); pm.test('each says which one applies', () => b.items.forEach(i => pm.expect(['BRANCH','HOSPITAL','DEFAULT']).to.include(i.scope))); pm.test('receptionist cannot change', () => pm.expect(b.canChange).to.eql({branch: false, hospital: false}));

item.name: 63 Branch Admin may change the branch only (200)
64 Keep the receipt template of this branch

exec: const t = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('tplBody', JSON.stringify({enabled: t.enabled, preset: t.preset, paper: t.paper, widthMm: t.widthMm, heightMm: t.heightMm, orientation: t.orientation, margins: t.margins, mode: t.mode, layout: t.layout}));

item.name: 67 Branch Admin cannot save the hospital-wide template (403)
68 No scope means hospital-wide: refused for a Branch Admin (403)
69 Branch Admin saves the template of their own branch (200)
70 The other hospital is not affected (200, not the branch template)

exec: pm.test('not a branch template of north', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().scope).to.not.eql('BRANCH'));

item.name: 71 Remove the branch template: back to the hospital one or the default (200)
72 Anyone signed in can read the values of the branch (200)
75 SuperAdmin adds a hospital value (201, or 409 on a second run)

exec: const v = pm.response.json().items.find(x => x.key === 'postman8c' && x.scope === 'HOSPITAL'); pm.test('exists', () => pm.expect(v).to.be.an('object')); pm.collectionVariables.set('valueId', v.id);

82 Branch Admin cannot add a hospital-wide value (403)

85 SuperAdmin deactivates it (200): it is no longer printed
